[LECC.1.5] **The engine rewrites a malformed code it is handed.** When the host
hands the engine a `CallError` whose `code` does not match [LECC.1.2]'s pattern,
the engine must place it in working memory with `code` set to
`internal.invariant` ([LECC.3.7.2]) and every other slot as given, and must
count the rewrite in `ds.errors.code_invariant_total` ([NMET.4.1]). No rule sees
the malformed code.

The engine checks [LECC.1.2]'s pattern and nothing more. A code with one
segment, which [LECC.1.3] forbids an adapter to send, matches the pattern and
enters as given.
